source.name: Ebon Fist
source.originalDescription: The user becomes unstoppable and the cooldown of Wicked Blow is reset when this Unite Move is used. The user dashes at the designated Pokémon from the opposing team, stunning them, then chooses whether to designate a direction to move or not. If no direction is chosen, the user pushes them slightly and delivers an uppercut, damaging the target, throwing them and stunning them when they land. If the user chooses a direction, the user instead delivers a more powerful blow to the target, dealing increased damage and shoving them in the designated direction. The shoved target also deals reduced damage to opposing Pokémon they collide with and throws those hit. Buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 30% CDR, 20% Max HP Shield
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Ebon Fist は 行動不能・スタンを付与する、相手を打ち上げる、相手を押し出す、妨害無効になる、受けるダメージを軽減する、待ち時間を短縮する、シールドを付与する。

source.name: Flowing Fists
source.originalDescription: The user activates the Flowing Fists buff for up to 10s, and briefly becomes unstoppable and damages nearby opposing Pokémon, shoving them away. If this Unite Move is used again, the user becomes unstoppable and receives 30% reduced damage as they unleash a minimum of 5 consecutive blows upon the designated Pokémon from the opposing team, dealing damage to the target and shoving them with each hit. After the consecutive blows have finished, the user delivers a final kick, damaging opposing Pokémon in front of themself and shoving them when it hits. When the Flowing Fists buff is active, until the follow-up attack is used, every 2 times the user hits a Pokémon from the opposing team, the number of consecutive blows for the follow-up attack increases by 1 (up to 10 hits for an additional 5 blows; maximum 10 consecutive blows). Buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 30% CDR, 20% Max HP Shield
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Flowing Fists は 妨害無効になる、受けるダメージを軽減する、待ち時間を短縮する、シールドを付与する、再使用・派生・2段目を持つ。
